title: Introduce runbook-linked callstack breadcrumbs and telemetry-playground launcher
author: Ava Kline
description: Motivation: On-call engineers and platform SREs need faster context when investigating token-cost and latency anomalies. Current traces and dashboards show metrics but don't surface playbook guidance or condensed invocation context. This PR introduces two complementary observability features: 1) lightweight invocation breadcrumbs (callstack anchors + token-cost hints) that travel with sampled traces and are surfaced in the Console and dashboard tooltips; 2) an internal 'telemetry-playground' dev launcher that lets engineers replay or craft synthetic invocations, annotate breadcrumbs, and validate alert tuning changes without affecting production metrics. Summary: - New 'breadcrumbs' header (x-rd-breadcrumbs) and ingestion path that stores compact anchors: route id, invocation fingerprint, top-3 hot kernels seen, token-cost-estimate, and optional runbook id hints. Breadcrumb items are intentionally small (<= 512 bytes) and are scrubbed for PII before indexing. - A runbook registry service mapping runbook ids to short descriptions and playbook links; Console surfaces suggestions when breadcrumbs match known patterns (e.g., kernel queueing + high token energy). - Telemetry-playground: a small local+dev-only UI and server that can replay sampled payloads, attach synthetic breadcrumbs, and run the alert evaluator against modified thresholds. - Dashboard updates: Grafana panels (observability/dashboards/token-cost) get a new compact sparkline with breadcrumb annotations and a runbook link action. - Alert tuning helper: CLI endpoint and Console flow that recommends band adjustments and quiet windows when a breadcrumb cluster spikes. Checklist: - [x] Breadcrumb header parsing and ingestion path - [x] Runbook registry + migration script (no DB downtime) - [x] Console: breadcrumb hover panel + runbook link - [x] Telemetry-playground package and quickstart - [x] Unit and integration tests - [x] Grafana JSON updates - [x] TLS and auth checks for playground dev server (disabled in prod) Safety/PII: breadcrumbs are scrubbed by the telemetry-scrubber with a new rule set; we do not persist user prompt text. The playground stores only synthetic or sampled, scrubbed payloads. Migration notes: the ingestion schema adds an optional breadcrumbs column to invocation_metadata; migration is additive and backwards compatible. Rollout plan: feature-flag controlled: breadcrumbs ingestion default off for existing customers; Console surfaces links only for internal tenants initially, then opt-in for customers. Impact: expected small storage increase for sampled traces (~0.8% daily ingest), but improved MTTR for SREs.

release_notes: Add small per-invocation breadcrumbs for faster SRE triage; runbook-linked suggestions in Console; telemetry-playground for safe alert tuning and replay. Feature is behind a feature flag and scrubbed for PII.
notes_for_ops: When enabling breadcrumbs ingestion for a tenant: 1) monitor telemetry.ingest.breadcrumbs.size and telemetry.scrubber.dropped_count for first 48 hours; 2) ensure runbook registry is seeded before enabling Console links; 3) playground should only be run in dev networks; if exposed, rotate dev tokens immediately.
testing_notes: Integration tests cover end-to-end ingestion -> scrub -> index -> Console hover rendering. Local playground quickstart: make dev token, run 'make playground-dev', use sample payloads in tests/fixtures to replay. Included synthetic replaybench to assert alert tuning behaviour.
risk_assessment: Low-medium: additive schema change and new ingestion path. Main risks are PII leakage (mitigated by scrubber) and increased indexing volume (estimated <1% for sampled traces).
